name: 97423 · Coquille, OR
findings: ZIP 97423 (Coquille) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 97423 (Coquille) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 97423 (Coquille) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).
